audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named a single Naafiri ability (packet defect) and called her 'he' throughout the full layer.
audit.why: Naafiri is female (champ-gender.js). Her kit is We Are More (P), Darkin Daggers (Q, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, 900 range), The Call of the Pack (W, 26/24/22/20/18s, untargetable), Eviscerate (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, 450-range dash), Hounds' Pursuit (R, 110/95/80s, 900 range, recast shields).
audit.corrected: Difficulty is the 450-range Eviscerate dash plus packmate damage against a champion with no dash and two interruptible channels. Hold more than a dash-length off the minion line until level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text invented an ability called 'Pack Your Bags' for her ultimate and 'Q Starfire' / 'Voice of Light' for Aurelion Sol's.
audit.why: Her ult is Hounds' Pursuit (110/95/80s), a lock-on dash at 900 range whose second cast grants a shield. Aurelion Sol's are Breath of Light (Q) and Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R).
audit.corrected: Spikes restated: her level 6 is a 110s lock-on dash with a shielded recast; yours is Rod of Ages, and the endgame is The Skies Descend on a grouped fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Q as her dash ('Q dash-resets', 'Naafiri's Q dash') and the ult as the start of her dive. It also told you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain'.
audit.why: Riot's Darkin Daggers text is two thrown daggers whose packmates leap — the dash flag on Q misfires. The real gap-closer is Eviscerate (E), a 450-range dash on 11/10/9/8/7s. Eviscerate's heal text is 'recalling her packmates and fully healing them' — it heals the pack, not Naafiri, so Grievous Wounds is not the answer the page claimed.
audit.corrected: Name Eviscerate as the dive opener and Hounds' Pursuit's shielded recast as the burst absorber to force out first. Chipping the hounds is wasted because Eviscerate restores them in full. Naafiri also carries no stun, silence or knock-up in her kit, so Breath of Light is not interrupted by her all-in — the beam keeps burning while you back out.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (catalogue defect 3) and the packet flags zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Real numbers exist: Hounds' Pursuit 110s at rank 1, Eviscerate 11s at rank 1, The Call of the Pack 26s at rank 1, Astral Flight 22s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rewritten around those numbers with an explicit wait-for-X-then-Y line.

audit.why: 47.96% over 367 games matches a hard early lane that flips on scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cross-layer chart disagreement on rows 6 and 7: phases[5].side said 'Naafiri' and phases[6].side said 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] both said 'Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: Two different answers rendered for the same row. The content layer is right — Naafiri is an assassin with no scaling wave clear, and stardust is permanent.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side -> Aurelion Sol, with ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood / tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — the titles are about Flash+R pairing and contesting her shove; the bodies described a flyby and a Q channel.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js) over aurelionsol_mid: female enemies referred to as he/him/his in prose fields, breakdown.cooldowns fields containing no cooldown number, Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title, "doubles" magnitude claims with no number, and report[4].t still holding the pre-audit template while breakdown.wave had been rewritten.
audit.why: Pronouns checked against champ-data/champ-gender.js; every flagged pronoun refers to the enemy laner, none to a jungler, so there are no false positives in this set. Cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits/. report[4].t is the report mirror of breakdown.wave and had drifted out of sync on 15 matchups.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to she/her. breakdown.cooldowns given real numbers. Bled Do/Don't bodies rewritten to their own titles. Magnitude claims given the supporting number. Stale report[4].t re-synced to the rewritten breakdown.wave.

notes: Naafiri is female — the full layer used he/his throughout; corrected. Fabricated names removed: 'Pack Your Bags' (her ult is Hounds' Pursuit), 'Q Starfire' and 'Voice of Light' (Aurelion Sol's are Breath of Light and Falling Star / The Skies Descend). Two derived-flag misfires handled per Riot's description: the dash flag on Darkin Daggers (Q) is wrong — the daggers are thrown and the packmates leap, so the real gap-closer is Eviscerate (E); and the heal flag on Eviscerate refers to fully healing her PACKMATES, not Naafiri, so the inherited 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' item line was wrong and has been replaced. Cross-layer chart disagreement fixed on rows 6 and 7. Not asserted: whether The Call of the Pack's untargetability dodges the black hole execute or Falling Star's stun — Riot's text does not say and the kit file's needsResearch is empty by design.
